brief.what_happened: On November 10, 2026, E.Leclerc faced 48 negative reviews (a z-score spike of 10.61 compared to the usual 6.6 per day). Users overwhelmingly reported that version 11.0.1 crashes on startup ("Impossible à ouvrir", "ne fonctionne plus") and prevents users from logging into their accounts ("Impossible de me connecter à mon compte depuis la MAJ").
brief.headline: E.Leclerc experienced a 10.61 z-score complaint spike on Nov 10, 2026, driven by app version 11.0.1 startup crashes and login failures.
brief.impact: 48 negative reviews on Nov 10 (vs 6.6 usual per day); app_reliability and login_access are top key drivers of rating loss (0.287 and 0.103 stars lost respectively).

actions.expected_effect: Restore app reliability and stop the influx of negative reviews regarding app crashes and login failures
actions.action: Roll back v11.0.1 or immediately issue hotfix v11.0.2 resolving startup crashes and login loop failures
Establish pre-release regression testing for authentication and cold-start flows on iOS and Android
actions.expected_effect: Prevent faulty version updates from reaching production and causing severe z-score spikes

actions.action: Publish an in-app notice and social/store response acknowledging the version 11 login/crash bug with an ETA for the patch
actions.expected_effect: Mitigate customer frustration and reduce churn among loyal card-holders and regular shoppers

brief.root_cause: Release of app version 11.0.1 introduced critical bugs causing app startup crashes and authentication/login failures.
